message:
vc_obj2tifxyz: write meta.json scale as grid cells per voxel measured from the emitted grid

tifxyz `scale` is a density (QuadSurface::size() == cols / scale; the
tracer writes 0.05 for its 20-voxel step), but vc_obj2tifxyz wrote the UV
spacing of the undecimated grid: a length, so inverted for stretch != 1,
and blind to --uv-downsample / --grid-cap, while --tifxyz-source ignored
any extra decimation. A 20x-decimated segment rendered 20x too small
(34x23 instead of 680x464 px at level 3), a stretch-2 one 4x too large,
and normalized UVs gave 1/stretch (#1319, vc_flatten collapsing to 6x4).

Measure the emitted grid's mean 3D spacing per axis in createQuadSurface()
and write its reciprocal for every non-source mode (mesh_units no longer
enters: OBJ coordinates are voxels); in --tifxyz-source mode reduce the
adopted source scale by the decimation actually applied. x/y/z.tif are
unchanged; only meta.json differs. Fix the scale definition in
lasagna/tifxyz_format.md and add a CLI test covering plain, decimated,
capped, stretched, normalized-UV and source-mode conversions against the
written grid.

Same approach as #1391 (auto-closed for inactivity), with the regression
coverage requested in its review.

Fixes #1319
